default.notes: A visa is required. Apply at a Japanese embassy or consulate.

groups.notes: Visa exemption for short-term stays (tourism, business meetings, visiting friends). Working is not permitted.
Visa exemption for short stays of up to 15 days. Working is not permitted.
Visa exemption for up to 30 days for holders of ICAO-compliant e-passports — confirm any pre-registration requirement before travel.
A visa is required. Citizens applying for a single-entry tourist visa can generally use the official Japan eVisa — confirm eligibility for your place of residence on evisa.mofa.go.jp.

JP.notes: Japanese citizens enter freely with a valid Japanese passport.

CN.notes: Japan restored short-term visa exemption for Chinese citizens (stays up to 30 days). Recently reinstated policy — confirm current conditions with a Japanese embassy or the MFA before booking.

ID.notes: A visa is normally required. Holders of Indonesian ICAO-compliant e-passports may pre-register for a short visa exemption (up to 15 days) at a Japanese mission — confirm current rules before travel.

KP.notes: Entry from North Korea is severely restricted under Japan's sanctions; visas are not normally issued to North Korean citizens.
